articleTitle: Development of a teaching discipline program "Fundamentals of scientific communications" in the specialty "System analysis and information processing"
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The main way to organize the interaction of scientists is to provide each participant in the scientific process with highly operational and high-quality information about the state of affairs in science in general and at its forefront in particular. This function is performed by the system of scientific communication – a set of types and forms of professional communication of scientists, carried out with the help of both standardized regular publications and a wide range of oral, written, printed and electronic means. The article describes the implementation of work program "Fundamentals of Scientific Communications" within the framework of teaching the specialty "System Analysis and Information Processing" at the Moscow Technical University of Communications and Informatics. Considered: program mastering objectives, list of planned learning outcomes for the discipline, discipline structure and content, thematic work plan, evaluative properties fund, as well as methodological recommendations for students and graduate students on mastering the discipline.

articleTitle: Application of Convolutional Neural Networks for Three-Dimensional Reconstruction of the Geometry of Objects in the Image
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: Automatic creation of three-dimensional prototypes and digital copies of three-dimensional objects of the real world is a revolutionary innovation that is actively used today in many spheres of human activity, for example, for identification of a person for various purposes, in intelligent transport systems, in visualization systems, as well as in digital systems for design, management and monitoring. This trend has intensified at the present time, when additive technologies have become available to a wide range of users, and large-scale repositories of three-dimensional objects are becoming increasingly popular and widespread. The problem of recognizing images of objects of the surrounding world and understanding their scale and volume by two-dimensional projections is one of the most urgent and studied problems solved by computer vision methods. However, this class of tasks is quite difficult to formalize, which makes their solution time-consuming to develop and implement. The article describes the development of a software complex that reconstructs three-dimensional scenes according to their projections using neural network machine learning methods: the basics of three-dimensional reconstruction are considered, a model of the overall architecture of the hardware and software complex is proposed the architecture of the developed neural network is given, as well as the results of training and technical experiments.

articleTitle: Intelligent Transport Systems as an Inclusive Mobility Solution for People with Disabilities
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: In the world, people are endowed with different health: some have excellent hearing, and some live in a world of silence. But we all have to travel somewhere, go to work or for groceries. The article explores the problems of mobility of visually impaired and hearing-impaired people. The authors reviewed the world experience in the development and use of intelligent transport systems. Identified problems that arise when moving around the area in people with hearing and vision impairments. This problem is solved through public transport navigation applications. A common drawback is the lack of a voice assistant or its interference when used. The article also presents the results of testing the application among visually impaired and blind people. In conclusion, the authors conclude that it is necessary to improve the quality of life of people with disabilities, and also compiled a technical task for developers to address inclusive mobility.

articleTitle: The Use of Multimedia Educational Complexes in the Teaching of Communication Theory Disciplines
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: At present, the need for the use of new pedagogical technologies in the process of teaching technical disciplines in educational institutions of higher professional education has become particularly acute. This is due to the peculiarities of the perception of information by modern students, the need to form their motivation for learning and to ensure the high quality of mastering the studied disciplines. The article presents the experience of the practical implementation of universal interactive forms of education that can be organically integrated into the process of teaching technical disciplines of the professional cycle. The interactive forms reflected in the article make it possible to greatly intensify the educational and cognitive activity of students, and are also effectively applicable not only for full-time and part-time forms of education, but also in distance education.

articleTitle: The Choice of Technology for the Construction of Fiber-Optic Communication Lines Along Railways and Highways
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: Implementation of modern information technologies in all spheres of activity of railway and road transport of a square reorganization of a developed industrial communication network based on external optical communication lines and digital transmission systems. The article discusses the technologies for laying export-optical lines of railways and highways. A method is proposed for selecting foreign-optical communication lines suspended on high-voltage overhead power transmission lines. It is emphasized that monitoring is required to ensure the reliability of communication.

articleTitle: Pollution Practical Research of Adaption Cruise Control System Radar During Winter Usage Condition
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: Adaption Cruise Control system (ACC) of Advanced Driving Assistance Systems (ADAS) radar performance was checked on public roads during winter usage condition. Evaluation was done accordance the test method was developed before. The test method main purposes are creation of mix mud plus snow (M+S) layer on radar working surface; finding max layer thickness when ACC stop to operate correctly; layer thickness increasing speed calculation. The test was done on toll Moscow – Sankt-Petersburg road during winter. It was comparison test. Vehicles as with upper radar location (on radiator grill) and vehicles with lower radar location (on the bottom part of front bumper) as well were chosen. Upper location: Volkswagen Tiguan and Nissan X-Trail; lower location: BMW X; KIA Seltos and Nissan Pathfinder. During the test the scene when radar was "blind" and ACC worked incorrectly were achieved many times. Mud+Snow (M+S) layer thickness were measured on such scenes. Layer thinness increasing speeds were calculated. The main conclusions are: lower radars are covered my M+S quicker than upper radars; usually lower radar layer thickness is bigger; thickness increasing speed in not constant and it depends from many external factors; heavier parts usually cover lower zones of test vehicle; additional radar surface heater reduces layer thickness significantly. After radar have been "blind" two possible ACC operation variants were studied. Based on practical evaluation at least two conclusion / recommendations were done: radar should be located as upper above a road surface as possible; lower radar should have additional heater.

articleTitle: Sound Source Direction of Arrival Estimation for Autonomous Driving Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: In the article, the authors introduce method for sound source direction of arrival estimation in application to autonomous driving systems. Since autonomous vehicles become more and more popular, problem of safety came to the front and became one of the biggest issues for implementation of autonomous cars into urban environment. One of the most important safety parameters for vehicle is precise environment representation. Environment around the vehicle is not only visible, but also audible, most of human drivers can hear and use auditory for environment representation during driving. That's why authors introduce sound source direction of arrival estimation algorithm which can be further implemented to the sound processing systems of autonomous vehicles.

articleTitle: Data Fabric Digital Array Processing in Road Transport Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The article discusses the technology of processing data arrays in Data Fabric using the QML language, which is a powerful open source data management tool. Data is an integral element of the digital transformation of enterprises. But as organizations seek to leverage their data, they face the challenge of handling data from multiple environments and platforms. This predicament with multi-dimensional data becomes even more difficult when hybrid and multi-cloud environments and architectures are implemented in the organization. Today, for many businesses, operational data has largely remained siled and hidden, resulting in massive amounts of big unstructured data. While it’s not enough to simply collect and store large amounts of data, companies need to seamlessly and securely access, manage, and use that data to drive digital transformation and successfully implement artificial intelligence. Data must not only be collected and stored, but also structured and analyzed in order to further use it to make business management decisions. Such decisions can be made not only by shareholders and top managers, but also by middle managers, as well as all employees who need it. In other words, data and the results of their analysis in a modern enterprise should become a service. Such a service should be as flexible and scalable as possible, easily adapting to the needs and size of the organization. Data Fabric solves these serious and complex tasks. It is important to understand that this is not a "boxed" solution, which is enough to buy, install, configure integration with existing systems, and then successfully operate. We are talking about methodologies, so you need to understand how they work, how to apply them correctly. The article is aimed at stimulating further developments and providing useful materials for future research in this area.

articleTitle: Problems and Prospects of Agricultural Tractors with Hybrid and Electric Drivetrain Creating
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: One of the main directions for improving the environmental safety of mobile machines is the implementation of a hybrid electromechanical drivetrain. Its application on tractors has a number of limitations in terms of energy saturation, functionality and control system. Features of hybrid power units and automated electric drivetrain made it possible to form general requirements for the tractor. Given the available shortage of tractors of small and medium traction classes in fleet of vehicles, the concept of a hybrid electromechanical drive is proposed, focused specifically on these tractors. A component base for the implementation of a hybrid electromechanical drivetrain is proposed. It is concluded that for the agricultural engineering industry, the creation of a self-propelled tractor with an electromechanical transmission is the most important technological step towards the creation of a fully unmanned vehicle.

articleTitle: Predicting Traffic Accidents Using the Conflict Coefficient
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The article presents theoretical approaches to the development of a methodology for predicting the occurrence of road accidents on public roads that occur as a result of collisions of two or more vehicles. The methodology for predicting the occurrence of road accidents is based on data received from transport detectors in real time. The advantage of using the method described above is the possibility of using it in real or forecast time. The described technique can be used for a comprehensive assessment of road safety on public roads, including in real time, when creating control algorithms for highly automated vehicles, as well as when creating intelligent transport systems.

articleTitle: Development of Requirements for a Digital Road Model as a Means of Implementing an Information Service for Road Users
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The development of a prototype digital road model (DRM) is necessary to improve the efficiency of traffic management and ensure road safety by using the capabilities of road infrastructure facilities. Intelligent transport systems (ITS) apply innovative solutions in the modeling and regulation of traffic, providing road users with information and safety. DRM is a part of the ITS and is implemented in the form of information and software components. The introduction of road safety standards on the road, where the participation of unmanned vehicles is possible, allows transport and the road complex to interact as efficiently as possible, improve the availability and quality of transport services to meet the needs of users and the country's economy.

articleTitle: Ensuring the Operation of Electric Bus Batteries in the Optimal Temperature Range
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: A traction battery is the most important and crucial part of an autonomous electric vehicle (EV). The battery cost remains at the level of 60% of the total EV cost. This fact causes the importance of studying the factors that affect the battery operational indicators, especially on the battery life cycle. The article reviews the number of studies establishing the influence of temperature on the capacity and life cycle of lithiumion accumulator storage batteries. The article also reviews various battery temperature control systems with the analysis of their advantages and disadvantages. Taking into account the above mentioned analysis, a two-circuit schema of the thermostating system is proposed for lithium-titanate batteries, used on electric buses. A mathematical model has been developed that takes into account an electric current flow in connecting electric busbars and heat distribution in the battery thermostating system. A numerical experiment has been carried out, the results of which allow us to draw a conclusion that proposed battery thermostating system ensures battery operation in the optimal temperature range.

articleTitle: Ensuring Road Safety Using ITS Services
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The development of projects intelligent transport systems (ITS) is necessary for the high-quality functioning of the country's transport complex. ITS is the future of a transport system that will function in cities like Smart City. Now the main indicator of ITS is improving road safety and traffic management, but there is a problem of the lack of uniform requirements for the platform. It is also necessary to integrate the public transport system and public utilities. ITS services allow you to change the concept of mobility management. The introduction of services will allow the state to control road safety. Thus, there is a need to legislate ITS services.

articleTitle: Platforms and Complexes for Unmanned Technologies in Road Transport
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The article is devoted to research in the field of designing hardware platforms designed for the implementation of computer control systems for unmanned vehicles and modes of robotic control in transport. The organization of traffic in difficult conditions is key for the transport systems of the regions of the Arctic zone. The solution of tasks within this organization is associated with the processing of uncertainty at different levels of the transport system management process. The article discusses various types of uncertainty, the manifestation of which can be expected in the dynamic process of management. Using the example of the organization of interaction of smart controllers in an electronic hitch, the authors substantiate the use of technological means of implementing the computing base of intelligent (smart) vehicle controllers that provide efficient processing of big data in in-real-time mode, the stability of the Intelligent electronic hitch system to changes in the topology of the connection of controllers based on heterogeneous components of computing means. The results reflected in the article show that cloud technologies, for example, can be used in smart controller systems of any level of complexity designed to control unmanned vehicles.

articleTitle: Optimizing the Development of the Road Network: New Approach
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: In most cases, the preparation of an investment solution in the road industry is associated with the formation of a promising road work program, which requires solving the problem of developing a set of road objects. This problem is very complex, as a rule, it has an extremely large dimension and cannot be qualitatively solved without the use of special methods. And the effectiveness of the developed road work program directly depends on how well the corresponding development task was solved. In the process of finding an effective approach to solving this problem, the regularities of changing the magnitude of the components of its objective function were studied. The resulting cost classification (benefit & loss-classification) is focused on optimizing calculations related to solving the problem of developing a set of road objects. It reflects the peculiarities of the development task, takes into account the specifics of the corresponding extreme calculations and makes it easier to find the best solution. The article sets out a new approach to justifying investments in the development of the road network, based on this classification of costs. For the practical implementation of the proposed approach, a computational scheme of the branch and boundary method was used.

articleTitle: Algorithm for the Complex Discrete Cosine Transform
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The main way to represent an audio signal in the frequency domain is the fast Fourier transform (FFT). When analyzing short signal sequences, the FFT often cannot provide the necessary resolution and accuracy in the formation of estimates of the amplitude and phase of the coefficients. The discrete cosine transform (DCT) is known and widely used, the coefficients of which are placed twice as often on the frequency scale. The disadvantage of DCT is the dependence of the estimate on the initial phase position of the signal; nevertheless, DCT is widely used to eliminate the statistical redundancy of signals. An algorithm for complex DCT is proposed that provides an increase in the resolution and accuracy of the estimate.

articleTitle: Parametric Synthesis of Computational Circuits for Complex Quantum Algorithms in the Transport and Road Sphere
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: Since quantum computing technologies are still in their early development phase, quantum circuits are created mainly by manual placement of logic elements. This development approach has the drawback of becoming inefficient due to lack of human comprehension when analyzing large circuits that correspond to complex algorithms. Because, even a slight increase in the number of operations in a quantum algorithm, could lead to the significant increase in size of its corresponding quantum circuit. Therefore, the purpose of creating Quantum Circuit Synthesizer "Naginata" is to improve the development and debugging processes of quantum circuits by introducing dynamically scalable compositions for common operations such as: the adder, multiplier, digital comparator (comparison operator), etc., turning them into building blocks for quantum programs, as well as providing a stable platform for creating more of these compositions. This way, our quantum synthesizer is opening an opportunity to implement quantum algorithms using higher-level commands. The programmer could implement a quantum algorithm with these generic blocks, and the quantum synthesizer would create a suitable circuit for this algorithm, in a format that is supported by the chosen quantum computation environment. With the help of simple command logging and using coding for building quantum circuits, this approach has the potential to significantly simplify and enhance the development and debugging processes of quantum circuits. The proposed approach for implementing quantum algorithms could have a potential application in the field of machine learning, in this regard, we provided an example of creating a circuit for training a simple neural network. Neural networks have a significant impact on the technological development of the transport and road complex, and there is a potential for improving the reliability and efficiency of their learning process by utilizing quantum computation.

articleTitle: Fourth Cumulant Blind Source Separation Efficiency Evaluation in the Task of Cognitive Radio
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: Blind source separation algorithms as a part of cognitive radio can be actively used in the task of building a smart transport system with a large number of licensed and unlicensed users. In this paper, the efficiency of the algorithm for blind separation of two complex signals is evaluated. The algorithm uses as a criterion for source separating the system of equations, which simultaneously nullify output signals covariance and fourth-order mixed cumulant. Unlike iterative methods, the considered algorithm is performed in a finite number of arithmetic operations. The paper investigates the similarity limit of input signals, separation efficiency depending on the sample size and signal-to-noise ratio. It is shown that the proposed algorithm makes it possible to effectively separate linear combinations of independent signals with a difference in the signal-to-interference ration in the input signals of at least 1 dB. It is shown that the proposed algorithm performs efficient separation of signals when the size of the sample used to calculate the statistics of the second and fourth orders is at least 10000. Compared to the FastICA algorithm, the proposed algorithm requires three times less samples to detect FSK-2 signals. It is shown that the proposed algorithm performs effective signal separation when the signal-to-noise ratio of the input signals is at least 24 dB.

articleTitle: Methods of Parameter Verification and Scenario Generation During Virtual Testing of Highly Automated and Autonomous Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The article substantiates the need to use virtual test methods to assess and ensure the safety and reliability of the highly automated and unmanned vehicles operation at the development stage and during operation. The software tools for generating scenarios for conducting virtual vehicle tests are described. The developed methodology for generating scenarios and conducting continuous virtual tests using Siemens Prescan and Matlab tools is presented. A technique for correcting the permissible areas of safe operation by integrating the developed scenarios into the HEEDS software environment is described. The results of virtual tests for one complex road scene are presented and a safe range of operating speeds for the considered driving conditions of the tested vehicle is determined. A successfully tested in practice scientific and methodological apparatus for verifying the parameters of vehicles' mathematical models during operation is presented.

articleTitle: Multi-Criteria Application Placement in Fog Computing
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: Fog computing has distributed, hierarchical, and heterogeneous architecture. Such computing environments are applicable in various Internet of Things applications, such as intelligent transport systems. Application placement to improve the QoE of various end-users is becoming one of the major challenges in the fog environment. In this paper, the multi-criteria application placement model for the fog computing environment is proposed. It takes into account such criteria as delay and cost with respect to resource constraints. Experiments have shown that two-criterion problem allows us to find the optimal balance between contradictory criteria, as opposed to solving single-criterion problem.

articleTitle: Methodology for Predictive Estimation of Specific Greenhouse Gas Emissions by Traffic Flows
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: A methodology for estimating specific (per unit of transport work) greenhouse gas emissions by traffic flows on certain sections of the road network is presented and its approbation is carried out. The main factors for reducing specific (per unit of transport work) greenhouse gases (GHG) emissions by traffic flows when considering different sections of the road network, provided that the composition of the traffic flow by type of vehicle, type of fuel (energy) used and environmental class of the vehicle, passenger capacity and carrying capacity of specific vehicles does not change, is the length of the road network section, the number of traffic lanes, the average speed and traffic intensity, which are affected by the presence of public transport routes on them, traffic light regulation. Reduction of specific greenhouse gases (GHG) emissions by traffic flows on sections of the road network in the foreseeable future will be achieved by increasing the share of electric vehicles powered by traction batteries and fuel cells powered by hydrogen in the vehicle traffic flow. It is expected that in the composition of traffic flows on the road network in 2054 there will be 20% of such vehicles in the composition of cars, trucks - about 10% and buses - 30%.

articleTitle: Simulation Model of a Bus Route
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: In this article authors describe a simulation model of a bus route, which can be used by specialists of transport enterprises to test various options for organizing work on the route and choosing the best one. The structure and description of the source data file for bus route simulation are given. The reliability of the simulation model developed by the authors has been proved, which makes it possible to use it for the designated purpose on any urban bus route.

articleTitle: Transport Management Systems as a Tool to Ensure the Flexibility and Efficiency of Cargo Delivery
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: Today, the development of the transport industry is characterized by digital transformation. It affects all elements of the transport infrastructure, such as the digitalization of vehicles, electronic document management, the use of digital solutions in the management of the warehouse and logistics terminals, electronic services for the interaction of participants in the transport process, checkpoints, electronic fare collection systems and much more. An important problem in the development of digital technologies of the transport system is the implementation of initiatives at the level of individual government agencies, commercial companies, and individual regions. There is no centralized approach to the development of digital transport logistics. The analysis carried out indicates the expediency of an exclusively systematic approach in managing the digital development of the transport complex. As an example, a study of digital solutions is being carried out in relation to one of the elements of the transport and logistics infrastructure - an international automobile checkpoint. This example will prove the consistency and interconnection of all indicators of the transport complex

articleTitle: Research Test Results of Low Voltage Electric Traction Drive for Commercial Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: Electric vehicles are safe, energy efficient and offer a range of operational benefits that are especially relevant in commercial operations. The parameters of the powertrain affect the characteristics of vehicles significantly. The main purpose of this paper is to find the correlation between the documentation data and the experimental data. The traction electric drive of light electric vehicles is used an object of research. In order to carry out acceptance control of the traction electric drive, experimental studies of the main technical characteristics of this system are prepared. A complex test bench for this purposes is created, and a program with methodology for testing has been developed. The paper analyzes the results of the practical implementation of bench test equipment, test results with relation to manufacturer’s data for ideal and real power source are performed.

articleTitle: Development of a System «ViDeS» for Monitoring the Dynamics of Traffic Flows Based on the Virtual Detectors Method
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The usage of computer vision methods to analyze such characteristics of traffic flows as intensity, density and velocity is an integral part of the functioning of modern intelligent transport systems. However, during video data capturing, there are a lot of crucial factors, such as the angle and video scale of camera, road illumination level, weather conditions and etc., that directly affect the detection accuracy. All of this requires the development of software with flexible settings allowing to achieve maximum accuracy for each specific case. The paper presents a description of the system for assessing the intensity, density and velocity of traffic flows based on the technology of virtual detectors - "ViDeS". The results of the system operation based on an array of video data collected from the higher mathematics department camera are presented. The system setup options and their influence on the detection accuracy depending on the time of day are described. A study of the processing time and detection accuracy depending on the number of processed video frames is presented.

articleTitle: Investigation of Trailed Equipment of a Machine for Installing Flexible Cable Fencing on Roads Using Intelligent Control Systems and Mathematical Modeling
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: Wire rope barriers are a prime example of an effective security system used to prevent vehicles from entering the oncoming lane. However, for pulling the ropes and installing the columns of the road barrier, human labor is used and the process is not automated. To automate the process, a complex has been developed for installing a cable fence on public roads. In this article, the authors consider a unique developed design of a trailer with equipment for guiding and holding cables, as well as equipment for feeding posts. The authors give a method for calculating the angle of descent of the columns, as well as an assessment of performance when comparing the operation of the developed equipment and the traditional installation method. To ensure the operation of the machine and automate the control of the working process parameters, it is proposed to use a set of software and hardware tools for automatic control of the TKO-1 parameters. As methods for estimating the parameters of the developed structure, the finite element method is used. As methods for estimating the parameters of the developed structure, the finite element method is used. To optimize the proposed holding and guiding equipment, the specific gravity control method is used. As a result, an algorithm was developed and presented in this paper. As conclusions, an assessment of the productivity and efficiency of using the proposed design is given.

articleTitle: Methods of Mobile Measurement, Data Collection and Analysis of Noise Near Highways
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: In recent years, there has been an increased interest in the joint measurement of environmental noise levels. The cost and immobility of professional measuring instruments is currently the main limitation of the number of measurement points. This article proposes an approach to the collection and research of data on noise pollution generated by highways when using software for mobile devices of its own design. Software has been developed for mobile devices to record the spectrum, control the noise level and track the location of the device during recording, as well as an assessment of the drop in the noise volume level depending on the distance to roadway and frequency, as well as evaluation of the effectiveness of the use of noise shields.

articleTitle: Road Transport CO2 Emissions Reduction Degree Assessment when Implementing ITS
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: Road transport CO2 emissions remain one of the first places in atmospheric pollution terms despite all attempts to reduce this impact. Due to the sharp slowdown in the transition of transport from fossil fuels to alternative sources, this is once again becoming a priority issue for governments, civil society organizations and the scientific community around the world. The largest share of these emissions is in large cities with high motorization level and small hybrid, electric vehicles and high environmental classes vehicles share, which is typical for the Eastern Europe, Russia, India and Latin America countries, incl. in cities with small level industrial enterprises. The best world practice is the use of automated traffic control systems integrated into integrated intelligent transport systems (ITS). The authors analyze the ITS introducing problems in a large Russian city with a population of 320 thousand people and a motorization level of about 320 cars per 1000 inhabitants. Collected and analyzed data on average traffic speeds and traffic intensity on the main streets of the city, estimated the level of CO2 emissions in these conditions. Further, information was collected on the planned ITS launch in the city and the potential effect of its implementation in the moderate and optimistic scenarios was assessed. For each scenario, the possible effect in reducing the share of CO2 emissions from cars is calculated. The results of experimental studies and data of mathematical modeling are presented. The results obtained can be used to evaluate the effectiveness of ITS implementation projects in similar cities.

articleTitle: Improving the Digital Modeling Quality of Unsignalized Intersections Equipped with a Pedestrian Crossing
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The design of elements of the road network in urban conditions includes digital modeling of traffic flows. The capacity and level of service of the urban road network are the main indicators of its operability. The effectiveness of the functioning of the road network is assessed by monitoring traffic and pedestrian flows. The presence of an uncontrolled crosswalk close to intersection has an impact on the intersection capacity and the efficiency of the road network. One of the factors affects intersection capacity and driver time delays is the critical headway that pedestrians consider safe to begin crossing the roadway. Taking into account the parameters of traffic and pedestrian flows observed in modern traffic conditions will make it possible to more accurately model road situations and assess the operability of elements of the road network.

articleTitle: Research of the Possibilities of Predicting the Structure-Borne Noise of a Diesel Engine when Changing its Design Using Modeling in the AVL EXCITE Software
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: Modern software systems for modeling noise and vibrations of an internal combustion engine allow us to take into account the design features of its body parts, which improves the quality of vibroacoustic studies. The article presents the methodology and results of modeling the noise of a 4-cylinder diesel engine when changing the design of its oil pan using the AVL EXCITE software package. The difference between the contributions of the surfaces of individual engine parts to the overall level of its sound power for the investigated variants of the oil pan design is shown. Analysis of the results of calculating the structure-borne noise of diesel in nominal mode showed that the change in the design of the oil pan led to a redistribution of the frequency composition of the sound power spectrum: the amplitudes of harmonics in the high frequency range increased, and the overall level increased by 2 dBA.

articleTitle: Programming of Traffic Light Objects at the Entrances of Urban Freeways
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The ongoing processes of motorization, urbanization and suburbanization in conditions of a shortage of the capacity of expensive roads lead to an excess of transport demand over supply, which in conditions of unlimited access to the highway network contributes to a sharp restriction of their capacity. The multiplicative effect in such conditions creates new hotbeds of decreasing the quality of transport services, most negatively affecting the overall road traffic situation in cities and their agglomerations. The article presents the results of research on the movement of traffic flows on sections of urban highways and suggests algorithms for the operation of traffic light facilities that allow providing high rates of transport services on the highway network by programming automated traffic control systems at the entrances.

articleTitle: Parametric Synthesis of Quantum Circuits for Training Perceptron Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: This work contains the analysis of results received after running synthesized quantum circuits for training perceptron neural networks. The training is performed by creating a Grover’s algorithm with a custom oracle function. The concept of synthesizing quantum circuits was showcased in the process of generating training circuits for three perceptron topologies, which were designed to test the accuracy of the synthesis process. The test circuits serve to prove that the proposed synthesis approach could be scaled to utilize more complex quantum computing systems and to solve more practical tasks. IBM’s 100-qubit cloud quantum simulator was used as the debugging environment. Quantum circuits for described algorithms are generated by the "Naginata" quantum synthesizer, its source code is published and further documented on GitHub along with the code for the provided example algorithms. The article describes the processes behind the algorithm for synthesizing quantum circuits that perform the training process of single-layer perceptrons by finding their weights by filtering all possible input values through a predefined accuracy criterion. Since quantum computing is still in its early development phase, quantum circuits are created mainly by manual placement of logic elements. Implementing quantum algorithms, especially more use-case specific ones, directly on the quantum circuit level could lead to the circuit easily becoming too complex for human comprehension. Quantum Circuit Synthesizer "Naginata" was created to simplify the development and debugging process of quantum algorithms, by adding better clarity to their development process. In our case, better clarity for the development process is achieved by composing functions for commonly used operations performed in the implemented quantum algorithm. The programmer could now implement the quantum algorithm as a set of functions, instead of manually creating a circuit from single logic elements. After this, the synthesizer would handle the task of creating the data for placing logic elements on the circuit. This enables an opportunity of implementing quantum algorithms with higher-level commands. In the scope of this work, parametrically generated generic blocks for frequently used operations such as: the adder, multiplier and digital comparator were created and utilized to form the training circuits. The test results, proved that with the help of the proposed quantum synthesizer, these compositions could be used efficiently as building blocks for implementing quantum algorithms. And by visually comparing sizes of both code and circuit representations of the synthesized circuits, to the code examples used to synthesize these circuits, it is determined that the proposed approach for implementing quantum circuits greatly simplifies the processes of development and debugging a quantum algorithm.

articleTitle: Improving the Using Efficiency of Secondary Auto Components in Order to Provide Sustainability for Car Service Companies
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The formation of a shortage in the market of original car parts, as a result of disruption of logistics chains around the world, can negatively affect the sustainable operation of car service enterprises and contribute to an increase in the number of accidents that occur for technical reasons. Alternative sources of spare parts can be the supply of original spare parts using other logistics routes, which leads to an increase in cost due to the complexity of logistics routes, the use of analogues of original spare parts that are manufactured in different countries around the world, but have different levels of quality, and it is also possible to use used automotive components of vehicles decommissioned. At the moment, there are databases of original spare parts and their analogues, where factors of time and delivery channels are taken into account. To assess the level of sustainability of the car service enterprises and the prospects for the development of the secondary spare parts market, including secondary, it is necessary to create a database in which the use of a dimensionless complex indicator is proposed, the value of which is directly proportional to the level of operational reliability of spare parts, their availability, based on the availability of logistics supply chains, the importance of parts to preserve the technical and operational qualities of the car and the level of awareness of the path of their movement, based on intelligent telematics systems, and also inversely proportional to the cost of original, new or secondary spare parts, including their analogues. It is established that the use of intelligent telematics systems based on a database on the market of secondary automotive components for the organization of effective monitoring of their operability can significantly increase the sustainability of car service enterprises, as well as improve the situation with the recycling of decommissioned vehicles, due to full control of this process and its recording in a single database.

Author Keywords: failure to achieve the required level of sustainability

articleTitle: Criteria for the Development of a Spatial Analytical Model of Urban Passenger Transport Routes to Ensure the Movement of Robotic Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The article deals with the development of spatial analytical model of urban passenger transport routes to ensure the movement of robotic vehicles. A robotic passenger vehicle means that the driver remains at his workplace. However, the machine takes away the steering function from the driver during the movement on each stage of the route, performing all the necessary maneuvers. The article gives a classification and description of the maneuvers that may occur during the movement on the route. The issues of constructing a spatial digital model of the route, containing, in addition to spatial data, parameters that ensure consistent with the nature of the route and safe movement of an urban passenger transport vehicle with a robotic traffic control system are considered. The actions of a human driver and robotic control system when performing a maneuver are compared using the example of passing a turn. The actions of a human and a robot are compared when performing analogous actions and the influence of the kinematic characteristics of the drive on the accuracy of performing control actions during maneuvering is considered.

articleTitle: Means to Improve the Efficiency of Operation of Electric Buses with Ultrafast Charging on Municipal Routes of Regular Transportation in Cities
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The article substantiates the need to increase the performance and improve the parameters of electric buses on the routes in order to improve the quality of transport services to the population. The factors and indicators influencing the battery discharging were determined. The analysis of the performance of electric buses and the degree of battery discharging on the existing routes of cities was carried out. The calculation of the need for charging stations and charging posts is presented. The aim of the study is to develop an algorithm for the formation of neural network models to determine the power reserve of electric buses, depending on operating conditions

articleTitle: Initial Planning Method for Seamless Indoor Wi-Fi Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: In this paper a criterion, method and algorithm for an initial planning of indoor Wi-Fi networks, taking into account both co-channel interference and intra-system interference on adjacent channels, as well as the room’s characteristics specified by its 3D map are developed. The developed algorithm based on a random optimization method makes it possible to determine the required numbers of access points and their location to provide communication for a given number of mobile subscribers in the service area. As a result of the planning, it was shown that the network parameters for the considered case were determined in 310 iterations with a full coverage of service area.

articleTitle: Restructuring and Reengineering as a Basis for Digitalization of Business Processes of a Telecommunications Operator
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: A necessary condition for the competitiveness of an infocommunication industry company is the effective management of its business processes, considering the prospects of digital transformation. Therefore, companies systematically analyze and change approaches to their management. The article discusses the issues of business process reengineering, which involves the restructuring of the company and is a catalyst for the digitalization process.

articleTitle: Improving the Efficiency of Electric Buses in a City Transport Company
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The article presents the current situation with autonomous passenger electric transport. This situation with the electric city bus fleet is considered including such parameters as the number of electric buses and their routes, as well as their development prospects in the future. Some issues and necessities for rationing electricity are described. Accumulate number is given for the actual electricity consumption of electric buses on urban linear routes of the city, obtained after downloading data from the on-board charging infrastructure of the electric bus. Moreover, possible prospects for further scientific activity (development and implementation of methods, regulations and recommendations), which will create prerequisites for further regulation of the operation of power-generating equipment of various brands and modifications of electric buses, taking into account the complexity of routes, temperature fluctuation and other factors influencing operation, are considered. The current situation with the operation of electric bus batteries is given and described, the main attention is paid to traction batteries, specifically, operating modes. Further prospects for the development of a regulation that will describe the operational conditions of batteries depending on environmental factors such as passenger traffic flow, ambient air temperature.

articleTitle: Investigation of the Efficiency of Detecting Road Defects Using Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: This work will allow us to evaluate the applicability of neural networks based on the Unet architecture for the tasks of segmenting pavement defects. The purpose of the article is to show the effectiveness of using this neural network to solve this problem, as well as to compare the quality of image segmentation for this problem. The leading research method is the empirical method, which allows you to compare the results of different algorithms. In this work, it was shown that the difference in the efficiency of using Unet with attention gates without them is different. Today, various methods of machine learning are increasingly being used to find solutions to a variety of problems. One of such important problems is the analysis of images and finding certain signs on them. For this article, the actual problem is the segmentation of pavement defects, which include various types of pavement cracks. Study of the effectiveness of neural network technologies for road surface image segmentation. The paper explores several types of neural networks aimed at image segmentation. In other works, this type of neural networks has shown its high efficiency for solving the tasks. This method will allow evaluating the applicability of neural network data for solving the problem, as well as comparing the effectiveness of these methods for test images of the roadway. It will also allow you to outline the direction of further work to improve neural networks. In this paper, the quantitative result of the work of neural networks on domain-specific data is obtained, as well as conclusions are drawn on the use of a neural network in this area. This work is of practical importance, making it possible to evaluate the efficiency of defect segmentation in roadway images.

articleTitle: Information and Communication System for Automatic Determination of the Moment when the Dividing Marking Lines of Traffic Lanes is Crossed by a Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: Currently, the ability to determine the location of vehicles is extremely relevant for monitoring traffic violations. However, this process is often accompanied by the installation of expensive equipment on a controlled section of road, which includes multi-stream video cameras, laser radars, etc. However, such equipment does not make it possible to implement the full scope of road control, namely, to detect and track the simultaneous determination of the position of several vehicles and their speeds. The problem of installing such equipment on dangerous sections of the road is complicated by its high cost, which is not always economically justified. This article proposes a solution to the identified problem of controlling the road traffic situation by introducing an information and communication system for automatic determining the location of vehicles on a controlled section of the road, with the help of registration means used to fix road violations. The paper also provides the principle of the system’s functioning, its composition and the structural and functional scheme. [1-3].

articleTitle: Digitalization of Transport Industry Using Information Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: Sustainable and dynamic development of any economic activity is provided, among other things, due to the advanced development of road-transport network, corresponding to modern regulatory requirements. One of the most important indicators of compliance with such requirements is to ensure road safety, a significant reduction in road accidents, especially with serious consequences. Also, a sufficiently important requirement to modern highways is convenience, sufficiency, unambiguity and speed of perception by the driver of all the elements of information about dangerous areas and changes in traffic regimes. A special role in ensuring these indicators is played by roadway elements, whose designs must meet such modern challenges of road infrastructure. Solving such problems in the design of road construction elements has become possible by using modern end-to-end digital technologies, such as information systems to support the life cycle of digital twins (digital models) of road elements, decision support systems, digital design systems using artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies. This article considers the development of the developed information system "MODAS" as a life cycle support system into a decision support system using methods and technologies of artificial intelligence. The article considers the development of an information resource by creating a data storage system for unstructured data of the design and technical documentation of the elements of road construction.

articleTitle: The Impact of Operating Conditions on the Maintenance Interval of Trucks Equipped with a Computerized Maintenance Management System
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: In modern conditions, an increasing number of trucks and special construction and agricultural equipment manufacturers are using new computerized maintenance management system (CMMS) instead of maintenance system with rigidly set intervals for mileage or equipment operation in hours. The latter allow use of individually adjustable maintenance systems for equipment that determine maintenance intervals depending on actual load on equipment and its operating conditions. From point of view of work practice, there is currently insufficient information on the final results of these systems operation, depending on changes in operating conditions and modes of equipment use. The article analyzes data on 22 units of Mercedes-Benz Arocs and Mercedes-Benz Actros trucks for 180-250 ths.km. mileage and service maintenance on them, service intervals are shown, influence of operating conditions on them is analyzed, and mathematical models for assigning maintenance intervals are built.

articleTitle: New Generation Aerodrome Washing Machine Technological Indicators Estimation
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: In this article, the design of an airfield irrigation machine (AIM) is considered. The calculation of operational indicators of the technological vehicle in summer and winter periods is made. The productivity of one nozzle is calculated, on the basis of which the flow rate of the liquid reagent is calculated, taking into account the speed movement of the airfield vehicle. The results of calculations are analyzed and presented in comparative tables. The overlap zones of the nozzle flare at a height of 150 mm and 300 mm from the road surface are compared. Based on the obtained numerical values, the optimal design of the equipment of the considered aerodrome technological machine is selected

articleTitle: Development of an Algorithm for Solving the Problem of Determining the Size of the Deflection of Road Barriers Based on Video Recordings of Full-Scale Crash Tests
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The most important state task is to ensure road safety. The solution is achieved due to various factors, the most important of which is the development of road transport infrastructure, the use of modern designs of road facilities and, first of all, road barriers, the purpose of which is to prevent road accidents and reduce the number and severity of injuries of injured participants in an accident. The design of modern road barrier structures requires the use of innovative digital design and analysis methods, as well as artificial intelligence methods for decision making at all stages of the life cycle of these products. The article discusses the use of computer vision and machine learning methods for the refined determination of the values of dynamic and residual deflection of the road barrier based on the results of video and photography of the field test process, which are carried out by driving a vehicle onto the tested road barrier. The obtained refined parameters will improve the quality of validation for subsequent virtual tests that are carried out for similar brands of modified fence designs, more accurately assess the effectiveness of various fence designs. Thus, the choice of the optimal design of the road barrier will be decided with lower resource costs and with a high degree of compliance with the specified requirements of the road transport infrastructure.

articleTitle: Efficiency Criteria for the Operation of Ground Vehicles in the Dynamic System of Transportation Management
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The article provides an analysis of the efficiency of modern transport and logistics networks of the Russian Federation in comparison with European and Western countries. The direction of perspective research contributing to the further development of cargo transportation in the country has been determined. The statistics of cargo transportation volume growth are analyzed. A comprehensive study of the parameters of the efficiency of the transport and logistics systems (TLS) was carried out. Criteria for maximizing cargo transportation processes are considered. The formulation and solution of the problem of optimization of control systems has been carried out. The application of the zoning method based on the principle of dominance of various possible options with the subsequent choice of the optimal one, which allows to exclude unfavorable decision-making algorithms, is revealed and justified to achieve the goal of optimization. A risk matrix has been identified, the elements of which show what loss a company or a legal entity may incur during transportation by using logistics services. The definition of the word "algorithm" is revealed, as well as its main properties and the degree of influence on the dynamically changing control system of the TLS are revealed. The efficiency criteria influencing the choice of the optimal algorithm for solving the problem are determined, namely: the Wald criterion, the Laplace Criterion, the Savage Criterion, the Guvvitz Criterion. The properties characteristic of each of the criteria are also determined. The matrix of choosing the optimal algorithm of the dynamic transportation management system is revealed.

articleTitle: The Methodology Concept of a Comprehensive Program for the Development of the Quality of Car Assembly Production
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The article presents the results of the actualization of the problem, as well as the development and implementation of a comprehensive improvement program for a car assembly company, which covers all the main activities in accordance with the current quality management system.

articleTitle: Methodology for Evaluating the Characteristics of a Three-Phase Inverter when it is Powered by a Battery
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The article presents the main provisions of the scientific and methodological apparatus for assessing the characteristics of a three-phase inverter when powered from a battery. The object of research is a three-phase inverter when powered by a battery. The research method is analytical based on electrotechnical design ratios. In the course of the study, the main characteristics of a three-phase inverter when powered by a battery were determined: the initial values of the currents, the effective values of the phase currents, the instantaneous values of the linear currents, the peak values of the linear current at purely active and purely inductive loads for load connection schemes in a delta and for star connection. The impact of the power utilization factor on the current and power of a three-phase inverter when powered from a battery has been evaluated.

articleTitle: Study of the Possibility of Using Langatate and Langasite Crystals as a sensing element in Vehicle Weight Sensors in Dynamics
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The main goal of this work is to analyze the possibility of using commercially available piezoelectric crystals of langasite (La3Ga5SiO14) and langatate (La3Ga5.5Ta0.5O14) as a sensitive element in vehicle weight sensors in dynamics, as an alternative to the already proven quartz crystals used for this purpose. For this purpose, we analyzed and compared the amplitudes of the output signal obtained at the faces of langasite, langatate, and quartz crystals using finite element simulations (in COMSOL Multiphysics 5.6 software) and analytical simulations. The results show that langasite and langatate crystals can be used on a par with quartz crystal to obtain qualitative results of vehicle weight measurement in dynamic weighing.

articleTitle: Airfield Sweeping and Blowing Machine Reliability and Production Manufacturability Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The article presents an assessment of the manufacturability of production, one of the tasks of which is to review possible cooperative enterprises for the manufacture of parts and assembly units of an airfield sweeper–blower. A primary analysis of the methods for obtaining components and assemblies in pilot production, which are part of the airfield sweeper–blower, has been carried out. A structural diagram of a purge unit for cleaning the airfield canvas is presented. The main difficulties in the layout and assembly of the installation are considered. Calculations were made of the wind speed at the inlet, the coefficient of hydraulic friction resistance, air pressure, specific pressure loss due to friction, the total value of pressure loss, the maximum useful power of the fan, the maximum possible power of the fan drive, the amount of torque on the shaft of the hydraulic drive of the purge installation, confirming its operability designs.

articleTitle: Losses of Energy Potential on Communication Lines Space Apparatus - Earth Station
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The energy losses of radio signals on the radio communication lines between the spacecraft and the Earth are considered, taking into account various natural factors that affect the conditions for the propagation of radio waves. It is shown that the ionosphere at frequencies above 5 GHz does not lead to a noticeable attenuation of radio signals, affecting only the polarization of waves and the group delay of signals. Expressions are given for the numerical determination of the attenuation of the radio signal during rains, as well as during dust storms along the communication path.

articleTitle: Generation of a Gas Diesel Engine Model for its Electronic Control System
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: Simple and fast models of the working process of internal combustion engines can speed up and reduce the cost of their development. Models can also be used to load into the memory of electronic control units of internal combustion engines in order to control in an optimal way all their adjustment parameters in a wide range of operating modes. A working process model of a gas diesel (dual fuel) engine was developed. It was based on a previously developed one-zone working process model of a diesel engine The assessment of the main differences in the algorithms for calculating the compression-combustion-expansion processes in diesel and gas diesel engines and their influence on the performance of two engines was carried out. To calibrate the model, calculations using the AVL FIRE multi-zone model and the results of experimental tests of a gas diesel engine were used. A high convergence of calculated and experimental results was demonstrated.

Author Keywords: gas diesel engine working process modeling

articleTitle: Informational Model for Calculating Road Surface Life and Repairs and the Rational Financing Thereof
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The article analyzes the use of geographic information system (GIS) to determine the indicators of longitudinal and transverse flatness of pavement and residual life of pavement structures with subsequent prediction of changes in these indicators over the years of road operation. The existing methods for evaluating the above-mentioned indicators are considered. The forecasting is based on the calculation of the residual total number of design load applications and the total number of automobile passes in the traffic lane, for which the forecasting is carried out. The article shows the possibility to determine the indexes of longitudinal and transversal flatness as well as residual life of the pavement structure at the present time by the data acquired by the video monitoring cameras. Video surveillance cameras record the dimensions of vehicles and organize the data on the structure and intensity of traffic. This information can be transmitted to the GIS in continuous synchronization with the GIS server.

Author Keywords: motor roads operating condition with respect to use for traffic

articleTitle: Blockchain Technologies for Validation of Priority Vehicles in ITS
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The analysis of the possibility of using distributed networks, in particular, the blockchain network, smart contracts, as a control mechanism for controlling messaging and ensuring the digital security of the network is carried out in the work. The paper describes the concept of priority passage and its provision using distributed network mechanisms. Two priority passage scenarios are considered, as well as a messaging scheme for general cases of priority passage and the case of overlapping priority routes. Also, the paper presents mathematical studies of evaluating the possibility of a blockchain network depending on its performance, as well as approbation of calculations on model stands on networks with PoW and LPoS consensus algorithms.

articleTitle: Alternative Power Sources Roadside Infrastructure
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The article considers alternative sources of power supply, which are based on various technologies and principles of electric energy regeneration. The authors propose an approach to solving the problem of creating an environmentally friendly energy source for roadside infrastructure, based on the use of a new physical principle for the road industry-a magnetic dynamic energy generator. According to the authors, among all devices that use the gravity of vehicles (vehicle weight) to generate energy, the proposed device is patented by the authors and implements the most effective way to convert this work into electricity. The article describes the principle of operation of the device for generating electricity due to the kinetic energy of a moving transport and a magneto-hydrodynamic power source. The use of a metal solid as a working element in a power source instead of an electrically conductive liquid makes it possible to simplify the design, as well as significantly increase its electrical power. The proposed technical solution is not only cost-effective, but also aimed at improving the environmental situation of megacities.

articleTitle: A Robust Method for Estimating Channel Data Rate in Seamless Wi-Fi Networks Operating in the Asynchronous Mode
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: In this paper the robust method for estimating channel data rate was developed for seamless Wi-Fi networks operating in the asynchronous mode. Its effectiveness is analyzed in comparison with the collective dynamic routing method with and without using a robust method for estimating channel data rate on IEEE 802.11ax seamless network segment operating in the synchronous mode, as well as in comparison with static routing. The developed method provides a significant reduction in the valid routes set dimension and the possibility of implementing the collective dynamic routing method on existing equipment. Also it makes possible to obtain higher channel data rates over the network as a whole compared to static routing. However, it loses to the case when network devices operating in the synchronous mode, due to more variants of intra-system interference.

articleTitle: Control of Oscillatory Process of the Common Rail System in the High-Pressure Line
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: One of the main advantages of an electronically controlled common rail system is the ability to repeatedly inject of fuel into an engine cylinder in one cycle. An increase in the fuel pressure level in them up to 250 MPa enhances the wave phenomena that occur in a pipe of common rail system. The result of the described processes is a decrease in the accuracy of control of the injection characteristic and cyclic supply. A device is proposed that includes a hydraulic valve with an electric drive (electromagnetic or piezoelectric) to compensate the wave phenomena and control them in the common rail system. The valve is installed in the fuel accumulator of common rail system and separates its volume from the low-pressure line. The actuation of the valve creates a pressure pulse in the pipeline. The characteristics of the impulse depend on the flow area of the jet, the frequency of operation, the design of the valve and its electric drive. The design of the obturator part of the valve determines the amount of unloading of the high-pressure line. The movement is managed by controlling the electrical signal sent to the electro-hydraulic valve, and thereby, the characteristics of the pressure pulsations created with it. This character of pulsations is selected for damping (weakening) ones in the high-pressure line of the common rail system caused by the operation of its injectors. It is made to improve the uniformity of fuel supply across the cylinders, as well as to give them the required parameters to control the shape of the injection characteristic.

articleTitle: Order Allocation Model for the Production of Asphalt Concrete Mixtures
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The necessity of solving the problem of order distribution for asphalt-concrete mixtures under varying intensities is substantiated to improve the selected performance criteria for the construction of extended facilities. We propose to use the construct of continuous Markov processes and describe an approach to determining the probabilities of transition from state to state using the Fokker-Planck-Kolmogorov equation. The resulting stationary transition probabilities of a continuous Markov process are the initial values for determining the optimal option of consumer order distribution over the ACP (asphalt-concrete plants), that is, for determining the optimal control variables. A piecewise continuous approximation of the initial function of change in the total intensity of incoming orders was carried out and it was proposed to use stationary values of the intensities of incoming orders at each time interval. The probability of failure to serve an order due to congestion at the ACP has been determined. Simulation results show that the probability of failures in order service reduces with an increase in the total number of ACPs and a decrease in their average load.

articleTitle: Digital basis for the development of an efficient route network of public transport in cities
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The article proposes algorithms for preparing a high-quality digital basis for developing an efficient city route network. Methods for preparing initial data in the form of forming a correspondence matrix, a connectivity matrix, a cost matrix, a passenger flow matrix are described. The procedure for preparing the necessary initial data is illustrated with specific examples. The required set of initial data was obtained for the city of Berezniki (Perm Territory, Russia). Methods for refining the algorithms for the formation of the route network are proposed, taking into account the obtained matrix of passenger flows, information on transit passenger flows through the existing stops of public transport.

articleTitle: Analysis of Factors Affecting the Resource of Electric Vehicle Energy Storage Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: At the moment, manufacturers of motor vehicles are solving the problem of creating electric vehicles with performance characteristics close to cars with internal combustion engines. At the same time, the role of the electrical equipment system becomes a priority, since the functionality of the traction and onboard systems depends on the quality and performance of its work. The role of state support should be focused on the development of this segment due to the fact that battery systems account for up to half of the cost of electric vehicles. Ensuring the efficiency of the technical operation of electric transport is directly related to the solution of a set of tasks, which include the task of minimizing the influence of various operational factors on the battery life. Understanding the factors affecting the resource of energy storage is an urgent issue, the solution of which will help the developing domestic market to take a leading position.

articleTitle: Analysis of Monitoring Data of the Experimental Section on the Moscow Ring Road
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The paper presents the results of a survey of seven experimental sections on the road, obtained using the complex multi-criteria assessment of the operational condition of road network objects "ADS-MADI". Examples of reporting forms are provided. A brief description of various methods of statistical analysis is given, using which the results of longitudinal roughness, transverse roughness, and crack density measurements for each of the 5 traffic lanes located on the Moscow Ring Road were processed. The results of the statistical analysis of all measured indicators are presented. The results of expert evaluation on a scale: the value of the indicator 0 − 20%, 4 − 20-40%, 3 − 40−60%, 2 − 60-80%, 1 − 80-100% The authors analyzed the dynamics of changes in the leveling indices in the time interval from May to September. It is concluded that the pavement of the experimental sections differs in their quality and wear resistance, resistance to rutting, and disturbance of longitudinal evenness.

articleTitle: Airfield Sweeper-Brush Machine Design Operability and Reliability Estimation
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The article presents the development of a blade for an airfield sweeper-brush machine.
