Research, development and technological work has been carried out, in particular, the development of structural elements, the development of principal and kinematic diagrams, both in assembly and separately for each element, as well as the installation of products. The main characteristics that the installation of the blade and the main characteristics of the support roller with a trunnion should provide are described. An equivalent design scheme for loading the blade during operation is presented, as well as information about the loads, material characteristics, parameters and results of splitting, inertial characteristics of the model, loads on the blade, material characteristics, parameters and results of splitting. The calculations of the blade installation for strength, stress, total linear displacement and safety factor were made. The most loaded places of the blade frame are revealed

articleTitle: A Model of the Decision-Making Process for Managing the Production of Asphalt Concrete
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The article shows that in real conditions it is impossible to operate with accurate data due to the random nature of the order arrival, random failure times of equipment, the probabilistic nature of the release of defects, which leads to the need to make decisions in uncertainty conditions. When considering the entire decision-making process under conditions of uncertainty of information, a model of decision-making process in the production of asphalt concrete mixtures is proposed. The universal scheme of the decision-making process in a fuzzy statement and the criterion of optimality of a fuzzy decision are given. It is shown that the uncertainty of quantitative characteristics of obtained admissible variants of solutions is composed of probabilistic uncertainty and possible uncertainty, for the estimation of which entropy is used. The process of automated decision-making is formalized and an original algorithm that allows evaluating the totality of options. The use of enumerative methods in finding the optimal decision, considering the preferences of the decision maker is justified.

articleTitle: Intelligent Analysis of the Results of Barrier Fence Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The article analyzes the results of monitoring the barrier fence installed on the road, obtained using the complex multi-criteria assessment of the operational condition of the street and road network "ADS-MADI". The capabilities of data mining, which allows making informed decisions on the repair or replacement of blocks and assessing the dynamics of changes in their condition in the future, due to the identification of hidden patterns, were evaluated. The authors classified the detected defects into four categories. Using a multiple linear regression model, an analysis of the reasons for assigning defects to a particular group was performed. The results of factor analysis, which allows evaluating the relationship between the number of defects of each type, are presented. It is concluded that it is possible to selectively diagnose some sections and calculate the remaining sections of the barrier fence by multiple regression. The analysis results of the defects distribution of each category along the road are presented and their interpretation is given.

articleTitle: Combined Road Vehicles with the Possibility of Changing the Composition of the Anti-Icing Material
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: This article discusses the digital twin of a road machine that distributes anti-icing material along the roadway. The introduction of digital twins of road machines will make it possible to estimate the amount of anti-icing materials distributed along roads, depending on environmental parameters. Since the change in environmental parameters occurs continuously, automated road weather stations are used for greater efficiency, and based on these data, the process of distributing anti-icing material by combined road machines can be quickly changed. In the process of developing a digital twin, the LabVIEW software package was used, and the algorithms for the operation of on-board systems were described.

articleTitle: Forecasting the Technical Condition and Risks of Construction Engineering Based on Operational Monitoring of Diagnostic Parameters
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: In the presented scientific research describes the issues of predicting the technical condition and assessing the risks arising from the operation of construction equipment, based on the analysis of information collected by the remote diagnostics system. This article describes not only the structure of the remote diagnostics system for the technical condition assessment, but also presents a few optimization measures taken to improve the reliability of assessing the technical condition of each object based on the totality of values of controlled parameters. It should be noted that the verification of the performance and reliability of the described forecasting technique was carried out experimentally. And, as a result, the developed system allows predicting the residual resource in real time. The system, using special subsystems with the possibility of self-learning, allows to calculate and predict data on the residual resource of each object connected to the system.

articleTitle: Pneumatic Waste Collection System Using Intelligent Systems as a Means of Improving the Urban Environment
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The article examines the impact of the use of PWCSs (pneumatic waste collection system) in the removal of solid household waste (MSW) on the urban environment. After studying the factors affecting environmental pollution when using PWCSs, the study concludes that it is necessary to equip PWCSs with a multi-stage filter cleaning system to prevent air pollution by emissions. Existing problems with the transportation of waste from residential buildings force management companies to close waste chutes, as harmful gases that are dangerous to human health arise. The sealing of the pipeline system makes it possible to exclude the ingress of gases from the decomposition of waste into residential premises. Installation of pneumatic transport systems in residential buildings for waste disposal will allow waste to be transported long distances from residential buildings, which will save money on waste collection and transportation. The vacuum transportation system is equipped with an intelligent control system that, depending on the conditions, opens or closes valves and controls the operation of electric motors.

articleTitle: Post-Quantum Digital Signatures in Transport Documents
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: Asymmetric cryptography plays a critical role in the security, authenticity and sustainability of widely used electronic documents on a level comparable to the security and authenticity of a traditional paper documents in transport and logistics. However, security of the majority of the asymmetric cryptographic techniques currently in use, including those used to confirm the validity of electronic documents, will be compromised due to the forthcoming development of quantum computers. The concept of a quantum computer is no longer just a theory. The race for supremacy in quantum technology is on among countries since it is the most drastic technology in the world. On a large enough quantum computer, an attacker can easily generate fake digital signatures by applying Shor’s algorithm. Digital communications and electronic transactions could be devoid of the guarantee of authenticity and non-repudiation if this vulnerability is not addressed. Post-quantum cryptography strives to provide useful techniques that are resistant to attacks utilizing quantum computers in order to address the threat to existing asymmetric cryptography. In this research, we examine the current post-quantum digital signature algorithms used to confirm the validity of an electronic document in addition to comprehending the utilization of digital signing. Overall, we conclude that in order to define the next generation of electronic documents and to address the quantum threat, it is crucial to standardize a quantum-resistant digital signature scheme.

articleTitle: Impact of Mechanical Properties of Steel on the Energy Absorption of Honeycomb for Truck Mounted Attenuators and Crash Cushions
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The paper considers mechanic of energy-absorbing honeycomb’s structures used in crash cushions and truck mounted attenuators (TMAs) installed on safety cars during road works or in front of dangerous obstacles on the roads on special services vehicles in order to reduce the impact of an accident and occupant’s level of injury. When a vehicle hits, its kinetic energy is converted into the internal energy of deformation of the elements of the construction. One of the factors affecting energy absorption is the mechanical properties of the material from which the structure is made and impact velocity. Basically, TMAs and crash cushions are made of steel or aluminum alloys, the properties of which differ. The impact of yield strength and tangential modulus of steel st3 on the energy-absorption of a honeycomb structure is studied in the paper using the finite element method by Ansys LS-DYNA.

articleTitle: Planning of Combined Delivery Using a Multi-Agent Approach
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: In the article, the authors highlight the prerequisites for the development of the transport and logistics system and the use of pooling technology in the Russian market. The authors consider promising technologies and highlight the pooling technology. In the article, this technology is considered in comparison with the combined delivery, noting all the advantages and disadvantages. The authors consider the possibility of using multi-agent technologies in the implementation of pooling technology. The authors consider the concept of a multi-agent system and define agents relative to the transport and logistics system. In the article, the authors give definitions and behavior patterns of agents for software development. Within the framework of the article, the authors identify the classification of parameters for the functioning of a multi-agent system, as well as a set of restrictions when making decisions by agents.

articleTitle: Evaluation of the Influence of Negative Temperatures on the Properties of Parts from Polymeric Composite Materials with Different Types of Post-Processing
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The proposed work is a logical continuation of the experimental work on the evaluation of the impact of post-processing made of ABS-plastic parts of a single-stage gearbox. For this purpose, experimental samples of the required type and quantity were made on a 3D printer and tested after two types of post-processing under normal temperature conditions. The next stage of research work is the evaluation of the influence of parts post-processing types manufactured using additive technologies on their physical and mechanical properties at negative temperatures. To determine the change in the quantitative characteristics of the studied samples at a temperature of -50 C° in terms of hardness, mass and geometric parameters, all the necessary regulatory documentation was selected and a LOIPFT-311-80 cryostat was used. A further direction of the ongoing multi-stage study is the research of the ultimate loads that allow the operation of the developed and manufactured single-stage gearbox. The details of which have a complex internal structure based on the conditions of their manufacture on a 3D printer. The results of the studies are presented in the proposed work.

articleTitle: Theoretical Foundations for Teaching the Causes of Non-Linear Distortions in Modern High-Efficiency Transmitters
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The issues of transmitting equipment energy efficiency are becoming more and more relevant during the transition to digital television and radio broadcasting, as well as an increase in the number of mobile transmitting devices. A potential way to solve this problem can be the use of active elements switching operating modes and synthetic methods of amplification in transmitters. This article has formulated the theoretical foundations necessary for teaching the causes of nonlinear distortions in modern high-efficiency transmitters. The reasons for the invention envelope elimination and restoration (EER) principle of operation - as separate amplification of modulated RF signals components are discussed. General requirements for OFDM transmitters - using the example of requirements for DRM transmitters are analyzed. How high power, high efficiency broadcast transmitters are built for the HF, LF and MF bands is discussed. Nonlinear distortions in EER transmitters are analyzed.

articleTitle: Software-Defined Radio Network Positioning Technology Design. Receiver Development
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: Recent trends in vehicles positioning include fusion of heterogeneous measurements from Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS), Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU), digital maps and cellular Signals of Opportunity (SOP). The last approach, utilizing ambient Long-Term Evolution (LTE) and 5G New Radio (NR) SOPs, is relevant for localization of user equipment (UE) in dense urban GNSS-denied environment. Opportunistic localization of UE testbed, being not a cellular network subscriber, is possible with Software-Defined Radio (SDR) receiver. Current work continues research, devoted to SDR network positioning technology design, and has the purpose to develop SDR SOP receiver. Methodology employed is so called Model-Based Design (MBD) in Matlab software and hardware platform used is Universal Software Radio Peripheral (USRP). Finding of current research is experimentally validated accuracy of several meters for primary range difference measurements in developed SDR receiver for the minimum 1.4 MHz bandwidth with limitation of ideal eNB synchronization. Practical implication of contribution is readiness to perform field trials of developed SDR positioning technology for vehicles.

articleTitle: Vehicle Positioning Requirements for Location-Aware Beamforming in 5G UDN
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: Location-Aware Beamforming (LAB) in Ultra-Dense Networks (UDN) is a breakthrough technology for 5G New Radio (NR) millimeter wave (mmWave) radio in general and Vehicle-to-everything (V2X) communication in particular. Directional links with narrow antenna half-power beamwidth (HPBW) and massive multiple-input multiple-output (mMIMO) processing systems allows to increase transmitter and receiver gains and thus facilitates to overcome high path loss in mmWave. Well known problem of pencil beamforming is in construction of precoding vectors at the transmitter and combining vectors at the receiver during directional link establishing and maintaining. It is complicated by huge array size and cumbersome channel state information (CSI) exchange, which is especially time consuming for vehicles. Knowledge of transmitter and receiver location could significantly alleviate directional link establishment. Purpose of this research is positioning requirement development for vehicles with LAB. Approach used is survey of current state-of-the art in the field of LAB and analytical modeling. Findings of research include channel coherence time interdependence on the vehicle speed, beamwidth, pointing error and positioning service level. Practical implications of results are in justification of vehicle positioning requirements for LAB in a separate link.

articleTitle: Principals of Optimal Cloud Resource Management
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: Cloud data centers are complex systems consisting of a number of subsystems, such as computing, telecommunication and engineering subsystems. Each of these subsystems has its own optimization tasks. The paper provides an overview of the main directions and tasks of resource optimization in cloud computing. Particular attention is paid to the computing subsystem, where optimization tasks such as initial and dynamic placement of virtual machines, optimization of resource scaling processes and migration of virtual machines and containers are solved. Based on the aims of the cloud computing participants, in this work the principles of optimal resource management, such as the principle of stability, energy efficiency and individuality, are formulated for the first time. The results of the work on the formation of the main cycle of computing work to optimize the process of managing cloud data center resources are presented.

articleTitle: Formalization of Learning Processes in the Framework of the Systemic-Cybernetic Approach to Management in Education
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The effective functioning of the education sector and the set of educational processes supposes successful achievement of global and local educational goals as a result of the implementation of management actions aimed at changing the state of the relevant objects and processes. The system-cybernetic approach to the implementation of control is based on the synthesis of a hierarchical set of various types of models, including mathematical models. The purpose of this study is to develop and substantiate a methodology for the implementation of the synthesis of the hierarchy of models of educational processes that provide an adequate level of efficiency and success in the implementation of management in the field of education. As a methodology, the basics of the system-cybernetic approach to management in education which were developed and modernized by the authors of this scientific study were used earlier. Primarily, attention is paid to the synthesis of a set of models of educational processes and the assessment of their quality.

articleTitle: Managemen Practices for the Introduction of Advanced Production Technologies
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The issues of introducing advanced production technologies are currently becoming extremely acute. To this kind of technologies, authors include technologies controlled by a computer and based on microelectronics, microelectronics. In engineering activities, the digital filler of each engineering system becomes dominant. This also applies to management in the transport complex. Therefore, management practices for the introduction of advanced production processes will, of necessity, be further associated with mechanisms for changing approaches towards combining engineering activities with digital support. An analysis of the practice of managing the implementation of advanced production processes in an objective sense was made based on official statistics, and a subjective opinion was presented on the basis of an expert survey " Innovative activity of the technical intelligentsia ", conducted by the authors of the article in 2019 (N=51). The authors of the article associate management trends for the successful implementation of advanced manufacturing technologies with graduates of technical universities, since they are much better adapted to digital devices. In addition, their aspirations for the successful realization of themselves in professional activities can contribute to changes in management mechanisms and the introduction of advanced production technologies.

articleTitle: Optimization of Ore Concentrate Transportation Indicators of a Mining Enterprise Based on a Logistic Analysis of Alternative Options for Organizing a Transportation System
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The modern transport and logistics infrastructure of mining enterprises is characterized by an intensive use of Industry 4.0 and digitalization technologies, which provide tools to increase efficiency, reduce costs, achieve sustainable development goals and optimize mining, processing and transportation of minerals. An analysis of the technological and socio-economic effects of the integrated use of Industry 4.0 technologies and the digitalization of the mining enterprises' main processes made it possible to establish that digital technologies increase the efficiency of deposits development, optimize technological and production chains, increase safety of mining operations, and simplify the processes of internal and external logistics. These trends (based on the rapid development of technical means of mechanization and automation of transport and logistics processes, the use of modern technical means of communication, automated methods for obtaining information about the location and condition of transport infrastructure facilities and mining equipment) made it possible to carry out a comprehensive logistical analysis of alternative options for transportation system. The constructed model made it possible to select the optimal complex of mining and transport equipment, taking into account mining and geological, technical, economic, and technological parameters.

articleTitle: Indicators of Trolleybus Operation Taking into Account the Environmental Factor
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The article presents the results of a comprehensive study of the economic efficiency of the operation of rolling stock in urban transportation – trolleybus with dynamic charging for a large city of the task – to identify a more profitable vehicle in terms of economic and time factors. The necessity of applying the proposed recommendations for the implementation of the process of comparing technical, operational and economic indicators, taking into account the identified advantages and disadvantages of existing types of rolling stock currently used: with a hybrid trolleybus, is proved. A statistical study of the dynamics of environmentally friendly urban types of passenger transport was carried out: the operational length of trolleybus and tram tracks, the volume of passenger traffic on public transport of the Russian Federation, the Volga Federal District and its constituent regions. A model of a step-by-step process of calculating the cost of transportation of a trolleybus with dynamic recharging is proposed.

articleTitle: Implementation of Adaptive Control with Parametric Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The article is devoted to the analysis of methods and means of effective implementation of adaptive control of non-stationary objects, in particular, objects that realize movement along a very complex and not fully predictable trajectory in advance. The authors paid special attention to a number of issues related to ensuring a high level of adequacy of synthesized mathematical models of the functioning of adaptive control systems for such a class of objects and their dynamic accuracy. The authors managed to achieve the corresponding results due to the synthesis and justification of a specific algorithm for converting a mathematical model of a non-stationary control object aimed at minimizing the dimension of a set of parametric disturbances. Equally important is ensuring the ability to coordinate certain actions and successfully predict the situation with the implementation of successful management in the short and long term.

articleTitle: Elements of On-Board Diagnostics of Vehicles with Various Automation Levels by Iterative Forecasting Method
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The article discusses the problem of preventing technical failures that can lead to an emergency when solving a tactical control task or a complete failure of the strategic task of driving a vehicle. Various types of diagnostics of the technical condition of a car are considered, in particular, at service stations, including visual inspection, the use of specialized stands or diagnostic complexes, as well as on-board tools, including direct and indirect. The author of the article proposes to use the method of iterative forecasting developed by him as a new type of on-board diagnostics. A mathematical model is presented for calculating the residual life of various vehicle units and their elements, such as brake discs, clutch, electric fuel pump, generator, constant-velocity joint boot, elastic suspension elements.

articleTitle: Principles of Integration of Innovative Information Technologies in Transport and Logistics Processes
publicationTitle: 2022 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: Digital information technologies (IT) are a crucial part for the further development and improvement of logistics processes and managing modern transport enterprises’ information flows. The volume of innovations in the IT field and the volume of innovative services for the transportation and goods storage have shown a significant growth in recent years. Moreover, it is higher than the average growth rate of the total volume of innovative products in all types of economic activity. When comparing statistical data on the costs of innovative activities and innovative products produced in various sectors of the economy for the period from 2018 to 2020, it was concluded that the volume of investments is not the only key factor of the company’s innovative development. The use of appropriate technologies and tools is also required for effective innovation management. The purpose of this study is to formulate main principles for integration of such technologies in logistics. Based on the need to utilize innovations immediately after installment, the implementation process must be managed by determining the order of them. Time is one of the most important indicators of effectiveness. A graph method was proposed and performance indicators were used in the study to determine the order of innovation implementation. The proposed principles of innovation integration are placed in order from necessary to mandatory.
